title: Aries × Aquarius: the snowman and the snow-bot.
old_caption: One of you wants it done, one wants it different. Ask about their idea, join in before it's perfect, and build the odd version together.

title: Taurus × Leo: two fixed signs, one couch.
old_caption: Two people who both know where they like to sit. Share the blanket, give up the good cushion now and then, and take turns choosing.

title: Gemini × Pisces: the subject change.
old_caption: Changing the subject can feel like helping, but sometimes they just need you to stay. Stay with the feeling first, then let the laugh come.

title: Virgo × Libra: the gift-wrap summit.
old_caption: Details matter to one of you, the pretty bow matters to the other. Praise first, say what you really like, and let the wrapping be imperfect.

title: Capricorn × Aquarius: two midnights.
old_caption: New tradition or the classic countdown? You don't have to pick one. Try their idea once and keep yours too. How are you two spending midnight?

title: Aries × Gemini: the snow-day race.
old_caption: One of you races ahead, one stops to text everyone. Wait at the door, put the phone down, and walk out into the snow together.

title: Scorpio × Sagittarius: the haircut review.
old_caption: Blunt words can sting even when they're meant kindly. Be honest and gentle, say when something hurts instead of storing it, and trade one compliment a day.

title: Aquarius × Virgo: Snow Tuesday.
old_caption: A big new idea can meet a lot of edits. Cheer the first draft, take the one good note, and build the thing together. What's your made-up holiday?

title: Aries × Leo: two fires, one tree.
old_caption: Two people who both love to go first. Let them shine, cheer their wins, and make room for both of you at the top.

title: Aries × Scorpio: left on read.
old_caption:
Read at 9:02. Reply at midnight.
Aries, send one and go live your life. Scorpio, a quick 'busy, smiling, call at nine' beats the perfect paragraph. Then agree on a rhythm, out loud.
